body: This should have a comment or something. It's iterating until it reaches the null terminator for the purpose of counting the string's length, but I could imagine folks getting confused by this.

```suggestion
	_FORCE_INLINE_ void set(int p_index, T p_elem) { _cowdata.set(p_index, p_elem); }
```
We can assume `T` will always be a simple type I'd say

```suggestion
	size_t len = strlen(p_cstr);
```

There are `strlen` overloads now for the other char types :)
I don't remember why this was here, but it wasn't needed after the refactor
This check isn't needed, but it's also not important to remove it :)
